scientific_integrity: All-length assertion has a self-contained prefix-branching proof; complete enumerations are cross-checks only.
scientific_limitations: This theorem fixes one complete linear palindrome-radius array, q>=4, n>=2. It does not count all fingerprints or their full fiber-size distribution, nor claims q<=3. Historical priority not independently established; the 2010 chapter was only abstract-accessible.
title: Sharp inverse ambiguity of \(q\)-ary palindromic fingerprints
